player.trait.title: Personality
trait.leader.body: As captain, doubles the positive effect of the half-time talk.
trait.hothead.body: Gets more cards, suffers more on the bench and doesn't like being called out at half-time.
trait.professional.body: Loses only half the morale from defeats and from the bench.
trait.idol.body: The fans want to see him on the pitch: if he sits out two rounds in a row without being injured or suspended, they cool off a little each round.
trait.quiet.body: Does the job without drawing attention.

lineup.issues.title: Lineup warnings
lineup.issue.idol: {name} is a fan idol. After two rounds in a row off the pitch, the fans cool off.
lineup.issue.short.one: Only {count} player can play: the team goes out with him alone.
lineup.issue.short.other: Only {count} players can play: the team goes out with them.
lineup.bench.title: Bench
lineup.out.title: Not selected
lineup.out.freeA11y: Leave out. Removes the player from the pitch or the bench, with no swap.
lineup.select.first: Select a player first, then use this option.

lineup.roles.removed.captain: {name} was removed from the captain list.
lineup.roles.removed.penalty: {name} was removed from the penalty list.
lineup.roles.removed.freeKick: {name} was removed from the free-kick list.
lineup.invalid.title: Lineup incomplete
lineup.check.title: Lineup incomplete
lineup.check.message: Before playing, the team needs 11 starters who are able to play.
lineup.check.hint: Players who can't play come out; the gaps are filled by the best from the bench (then the squad) and the bench is back to 7. The rest stays as you left it.
lineup.strength.help.label: What counts toward Strength
lineup.strength.help.full: Strength is the average rating of the starters in the spot where each one plays, minus tiredness. Defense, Midfield and Attack already include the formation. Morale, home advantage, approach and pressing count in the match, not here.
lineup.strength.help.simplified: Strength is the average rating of the starters in the spot where each one plays. Defense, Midfield and Attack already include the formation. Morale, home advantage, approach and pressing count in the match, not here.
lineup.issue.tired: {name} is tired (fitness {condition}): plays worse and is more injury-prone.
tactic.formation.note: Nobody leaves the team: each starter keeps the same position if it exists in the new formation; the rest go to open spots.
tactic.formation.4-4-2.effect: Balanced: four at the back, four in midfield, two up front.
tactic.formation.4-3-3.effect: Three up front; midfield gives up a little.
tactic.formation.4-2-3-1.effect: Strong midfield; attack loses a little with a lone striker.
tactic.formation.3-5-2.effect: Packed midfield with wing-backs; with three at the back, defense loses a little.
tactic.formation.3-4-3.effect: Three attackers; the defense is left exposed.
tactic.formation.5-3-2.effect: Five at the back; midfield and attack give up a little.
tactic.issues.title: In this formation
tactic.posture.defensive.effect: Creates fewer chances and concedes fewer.
tactic.posture.balanced.effect: The starting point: no more, no less.
tactic.posture.attacking.effect: Creates more chances and concedes more.
tactic.pressure.low.effect: Midfield does less, but tires less and gets fewer cards.
tactic.pressure.high.effect: Midfield does more (more chances and more possession), but tires more and gets more cards.

roles.penalty.title: Penalty taker
roles.freeKick.title: Free-kick taker
roles.captain.intro: The first player on the list who is on the pitch wears the armband.
roles.taker.intro: The first player on the list who is on the pitch takes it.
roles.empty: Empty list: the automatic rule applies.
roles.auto.captain: If nobody on the list is on the pitch: the leader on the pitch (the highest rated, if several); with no leader, the oldest.
roles.auto.penalty: If nobody on the list is on the pitch: the one with the highest Finishing.
roles.auto.freeKick: If nobody on the list is on the pitch: the one with the highest Technique.
roles.full: The list holds up to {max}. Remove someone to add another.
roles.order.empty: {role}: empty list, the automatic rule applies.
